name: caption-editor
description: A WebVTT caption file editor with media playback support, including synchronizing selected caption with the current position of the media playback.
author: Thad Hughes

scripts.build:electron: vite build --config vite.electron.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:rust: sh -c 'BAZEL=$(command -v bazelisk || command -v bazel) && "$BAZEL" build //transcribe_rs/transcribe-rs //transcribe_rs/embed-rs' && mkdir -p dist-rust && cp -f bazel-bin/transcribe_rs/transcribe-rs/transcribe-rs bazel-bin/transcribe_rs/embed-rs/embed-rs dist-rust/ && chmod +x dist-rust/transcribe-rs dist-rust/embed-rs && npm run build:ffmpeg && npm run build:wespeaker-onnx
scripts.package: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && electron-builder --mac --win --linux -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('electron/constants.ts','utf8').match(/APP_VERSION = '(.+)'/)[1]")
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && electron-builder --mac -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('electron/constants.ts','utf8').match(/APP_VERSION = '(.+)'/)[1]")
scripts.package:win: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && electron-builder --win -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('electron/constants.ts','utf8').match(/APP_VERSION = '(.+)'/)[1]")
scripts.package:linux: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && electron-builder --linux -c.extraMetadata.version=$(node -p "require('fs').readFileSync('electron/constants.ts','utf8').match(/APP_VERSION = '(.+)'/)[1]")
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && playwright test --grep-invert @expensive
scripts.test:e2e:expensive: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && playwright test --grep @expensive
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && playwright test --grep-invert @expensive --ui
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run build:all && npm run build:rust && npm run verify:dist-rust && playwright test --grep-invert @expensive --headed
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:e2e --reporter=html && npx nyc report --reporter=text --reporter=html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:build
